cohort: Preterm infants (<34 weeks gestational age) admitted to NICU between 2009 and 2013, with or without a diagnosis of early onset pulmonary arterial hypertension in the first 2 weeks of age.
finding: Early onset pulmonary arterial hypertension (EOPAH) in preterm infants is associated with bronchopulmonary dysplasia and severe intraventricular hemorrhage, and its occurrence is linked to prolonged rupture of membrane, oligohydramnios, and less antenatal steroid exposure.
birth_weight: Varied, matched between cases and controls
